subject.title: fix(nextcloud-talk): preserve current-room aliases across plugin upgrades

question: Should shared core message dispatch guarantee a canonical active-target sibling for older independently released external channel plugins after exact-current authorization succeeds?
rationale: The code is a focused regression repair, but it establishes cross-version behavior at the core/plugin ownership boundary rather than fixing only the Nextcloud Talk package.

options.title: Accept the shared compatibility contract
options.body: Merge after confirming the failing shard is unrelated or fixed, treating canonical active-target handoff as a supported core guarantee for external plugins.

options.title: Move compatibility into the plugin
options.body: Keep the current core contract unchanged and implement an explicit legacy-target normalization path in the Nextcloud Talk plugin instead.

options.title: Pause for plugin API guidance
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers specify whether external plugins may rely on this canonical sibling and how long the compatibility promise should last.
